描述_EN: shadow puppetry has been immensely popular in china, but due to its universal appeal was forbidden in china between 1796 to 1800, for fear of spreading peasant uprising. its chinese name 'pi ying' means 'shadow of hides' since the puppets were traditionally made from the donkey or ox hide. one operates the puppets, one plays a suo-na horn, and a yu-kin, one plays banhu fiddle, one is in charge of percussion instruments, and one sings. a chinese shadow puppet troupe is made up of five people. chinese shadow puppetry is said to be over 2000 years old.
描述_ZN: 皮影戏在中国非常流行，但由于其普遍的吸引力，在1796年至1800年期间，由于担心农民起义的蔓延，在中国被禁止。 其中文名称 "皮影 "意为 "皮影"，因为传统上皮影是用驴皮或牛皮制作的。 一个操作木偶，一个吹唢呐，一个吹玉琴，一个拉板胡，一个负责打击乐器，一个唱歌。 一个中国皮影戏团是由五个人组成的。 中国皮影戏据说有2000多年的历史。
